[[File:ThatsASpicyMeatball-CW25.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Skakoan dies from explosive decompression when his pressure suit is ruptured.]]
'''Explosive decompression''' was the process where a being exposed to an unpressurized environment&mdash;usually when exposed to a [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]&mdash;was rapidly crushed from an increase in pressure, and [[Death/Legends|died]]. [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]] wore a [[Pressure suit/Legends|special suit]] to prevent this as they were unable to survive in most environments. If this suit was ruptured, the Skakoan in question would instantly die.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/PHSkako|series=Planet Hoppers|text=Skako}}</ref>

Explosive decompression also occurred to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The physics in hyperspace were unpredictable, and whereas a ship's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] typically exploded outward, a breached part of a ship could simply leave it in a seismic tug, eventually exiting hyperspace and reverting to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]]. When the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] collided with the ''[[Omen]]'' just as the latter entered hyperspace in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the ''Omen''{{'s}} armory and a part of its quarterdeck was torn away from the [[Sith dreadnaught]] by a seismic tug.<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>

When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] crashed their [[ScragHull commando boat]] into the ''[[Ormni]]'' [[asteroid crusher]], the pair narrowly escaped the explosion of their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Fusion generator/Legends|fusion core]] along with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] by locking themselves in a locker room aboard the ''Ormni'', albeit with severe injuries. The ''Ormni''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Palis]] was certain that there were no survivors, given that the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the ScragHull would have had to endure the explosion of a fusion core and the resulting explosive decompression of the vault that they crashed into; however, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Vestara Khai]] asserted that it was possible for pilots to survive such an ordeal.<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
